main_text.p: fas,publicas,priuatas,liberas, feruas, ue[?]tigales, immunes: tertiò,rerũ alienandarum & acquirendarum modos omnes,inuentionem,occupationem,abalienationem,usucapionem,stipulationem, in iu re cessionem,emptioné, conductionem,ceteraq; rerum cōtrahendarū genera: quartò,iudicia tum publica, tum priuata, quæ ex contractu, maleficio, lege, alijsque modis cōflata & nata sunt. Quibus ita dispositis, odineq; demonstratis, sensim ad summam iuris cognitionem, tan quam ad fastigium peruenitur. & si quæratur, exempli cau-

page.notes: The running head is in spaced, decorative type; only "II." is clearly legible, the rest is illegible. "ue[?]tigales" is probably uectigales; the letter after "ue" is a long s/t ligature that I could not read with certainty. "in iu re" is printed with a space inside the word, which I left as printed. "perueni-tur" is hyphenated at the line end as printed. The long s is read as plain s throughout. The page ends mid-word at "cau-", as printed, with no catchword.
